title: Commitment activation & market onramp: new region + instance family launch
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Objective: Safely enable customer commitments and flexible reservations for the new eu-west-3 region and the G5x instance family. Scope covers SKU definitions, reservation lifecycle (purchase -> activation -> conversion), billing alignment, release-note coordination, ops runbooks, and sales/partner enablement. This ticket coordinates cross-functional readiness and the runway to GA activation.

Out of scope: underlying firmware/hypervisor work owned by infra hardware partners; deep billing platform refactors beyond the reservation API surface (those are tracked in ENG-61300).
success_metrics:
- First-week reservations activated: >= 40% of pre-sold volume
- Median activation latency (purchase -> usable): < 6 minutes
- Reservation conversion rate from trials: >= 22% after 30 days
- No Sev1 incidents tied to activation in first 2 weeks
rollout_plan:
1) Soft-onramp: invite-only activation for existing enterprise customers (72h window)
2) Phased enablement: region open for Dedicated customers with pre-reserved SKUs + bursts
3) Public GA: marketing announce + docs update
4) Contingency: immediate automatic fallback to compatible instance families if capacity errors exceed threshold
release_notes_requirements:
- Clear SKU mapping table for new G5x variants
- Developer note: new quota semantics and billing effective date
- Known limitations: no GPU live-migrate, KV cache size differences on G5x
- Migration guidance and sample API calls for converting pre-existing reservations
acceptance_criteria: SKU definitions published in catalog and tagged in model-service
Reservation purchase -> activation flow validated in staging with synthetic purchases
Billing delta validated with finance for 3 sample invoices
Release notes drafted and reviewed by Docs + Legal
Support runbook created and reviewed by L2 lead
qa_checklist: Activation under burst loads (100 concurrent purchases)
Failure injection: pay service delay and expected retry behavior
Billing reconciliation smoke test vs. expected invoice rows
risks: Capacity misreporting during high churn resulting in 5xxs
Billing edge-case for swapped reservations causing incorrect invoice lines
Support scale gap for early adopters in CET timezone
mitigations: Billing team to run pre-GA reconciliation job for first 500 activations
Support on-call ramp with a dedicated war-room channel and 2 sales-engineering liaisons

open_questions: If activation latency spikes above SLA, what's the automated rollback threshold? (proposal: 10% 5xxs over 5m)
Do we allow cross-region reservation consolidation for customers with multi-region commitments? (legal + billing input needed)
Are we supporting in-place reservation upgrades (G4x -> G5x) at GA?
decisions: Reserve soft-onramp for invite-only customers to catch billing edge-cases early
Disable automatic cross-region consolidation at GA until legal sign-off
